description: Java class implementing a rule node for publishing messages to AWS SNS within the Thingsboard platform. It initializes an SNS client, handles message publishing asynchronously, and processes results and exceptions.

classes.name: TbSnsNode
classes.description: A rule node class for publishing messages to AWS SNS, managing SNS client lifecycle, and processing message results.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SNS client with credentials and region based on configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, initiates asynchronous publishing, and manages success/failure callbacks.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes a message to SNS and processes the result.

methods.name: processPublishResult
methods.description: Adds message ID and request ID from SNS response to message metadata.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Adds error information to message metadata when an exception occurs.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the SNS client during node destruction.
